import json
# Test with various Unicode escape sequences
tests = [
    '{\"a\": \"\u0041\"}',  # Simple ASCII
    '{\"a\": \"\u4e2d\u6587\"}',  # Chinese characters
    '{\"a\": \"\ud83c\udf89\"}',  # Emoji (surrogate pair)
    '{\"a\": \"\u2026\"}',  # Ellipsis
]

for i, test in enumerate(tests):
    result = json.loads(test)
    print(f'Test {i+1}: {repr(test)}')
    print(f'  Result: {repr(result)}')
    print(f'  Value: {result[\"a\"]}')
    print()
